title: Uniform dilution buys time rather than optimized selectivity
statement: Scaling both hazards100fold down leaves optimized gmax unchanged but increases twenty-pulse time1165.32to116532s. Reducing only u tenfold gives.9524811 twenty-stage correctness at81.1416s/pulse; hundredfold gives.9937707 at104.146s. In this protocol90%exact twenty-stage correctness requires u/a<=.0007286803 or a/u>=1372.344. This is not a general molecular selectivity bound or a refutation of a different multipulse ODE; protected intermediates, selective local registers, clearing and other topologies remain physical alternatives.
